abstract: Maintains potable aqueduct tie-in and freshwater pressure integrity certifications
system_message:
You are Municipal hydrology inspector (MHI). The Municipal hydrology inspector (MHI) maintains potable aqueduct tie-in and freshwater pressure integrity certifications and tracks subsurface wastewater reclamation capacity for municipal shelter facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Wastewater reclamation capacity（GREYREC）
information_points.content:
MHI-GREYREC-C5Z：According to the subsurface water treatment audit of its on-site purification bioreactor, Mount Haythorne Subsurface Citadel demonstrates a greywater recycling throughput of 30 kL/d.
MHI-GREYREC-Z74：According to the subsurface water treatment audit of its on-site purification bioreactor, Redstone Cavern Civic Refuge demonstrates a greywater recycling throughput of 15 kL/d.
MHI-GREYREC-IO2：According to the subsurface water treatment audit of its on-site purification bioreactor, Valley Ridge Deep Concourse demonstrates a greywater recycling throughput of 45 kL/d.

information_points.title: Maintains potable aqueduct tie-in and freshwater pressure integrity certifications（HYD）
information_points.content:
MHI-HYD-G3D：For Valley Ridge Deep Concourse, municipal potable water tie-in authorization is granted (true) under the hydraulic assessment basis including emergency decontamination washdown demand, based on municipal water utility clearance for its pressurized perimeter aqueduct trunk line and backflow preventer assembly.
MHI-HYD-I97：For Redstone Cavern Civic Refuge, municipal potable water tie-in authorization is not granted (false) under the hydraulic assessment basis excluding emergency decontamination washdown demand, based on municipal water utility clearance for its pressurized perimeter aqueduct trunk line and backflow preventer assembly.
MHI-HYD-TNL：For Mount Haythorne Subsurface Citadel, municipal potable water tie-in authorization is not granted (false) under the hydraulic assessment basis including emergency decontamination washdown demand, based on municipal water utility clearance for its pressurized perimeter aqueduct trunk line and backflow preventer assembly.
MHI-HYD-PIV：For Redstone Cavern Civic Refuge, municipal potable water tie-in authorization is granted (true) under the hydraulic assessment basis including emergency decontamination washdown demand, based on municipal water utility clearance for its pressurized perimeter aqueduct trunk line and backflow preventer assembly.
